name: code-block-examples
title: Code Block examples
description: The examples from the shadcn/ui Code Block docs.

files.content:
---
import {
  CodeBlock,
  CodeBlockActions,
  CodeBlockContent,
  CodeBlockCopyButton,
  CodeBlockHeader,
  CodeBlockTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/code-block"

const code = `import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button href="/contact/">Contact us</Button>`
---

<CodeBlock class="max-w-lg">
  <CodeBlockHeader>
    <CodeBlockTitle>contact.astro</CodeBlockTitle>
    <CodeBlockActions>
      <CodeBlockCopyButton value={code} />
    </CodeBlockActions>
  </CodeBlockHeader>
  <CodeBlockContent code={code} />
</CodeBlock>

---
import {
  CodeBlock,
  CodeBlockContent,
  CodeBlockLine,
} from "@/components/ui/code-block"
---

<CodeBlock class="max-w-lg">
  <CodeBlockContent lineNumbers startLine={12}>
    <CodeBlockLine>export const site = {</CodeBlockLine>
    <CodeBlockLine variant="removed">{'  title: "Our website",'}</CodeBlockLine>
    <CodeBlockLine variant="added">
      {'  title: "Our new website",'}
    </CodeBlockLine>
    <CodeBlockLine />
    <CodeBlockLine variant="highlighted">{'  lang: "en",'}</CodeBlockLine>
    <CodeBlockLine>}</CodeBlockLine>
  </CodeBlockContent>
</CodeBlock>

---
import { CodeBlock, CodeBlockContent } from "@/components/ui/code-block"

const code = `{
  "name": "our-website",

  "private": true
}`
---

<CodeBlock class="max-w-lg">
  <CodeBlockContent code={code} lineNumbers />
</CodeBlock>

---
import {
  CodeBlock,
  CodeBlockActions,
  CodeBlockContent,
  CodeBlockCopyButton,
  CodeBlockFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/code-block"

const code =
  "A long explanation can wrap inside a code block without making the surrounding article or the page scroll horizontally."
---

<CodeBlock size="sm" class="max-w-sm">
  <CodeBlockActions>
    <CodeBlockCopyButton value={code} />
  </CodeBlockActions>
  <CodeBlockContent code={code} wrap />
  <CodeBlockFooter>Plain text, with line wrapping.</CodeBlockFooter>
</CodeBlock>
